title: General Patient Intake
description: Comprehensive new-patient intake covering demographics, past medical history, surgical history, medications, allergies, social history, family history, and review of systems. Based on the Stanford Adult Patient Questionnaire and WakeMed Urgent Care intake form.

sections.title: Reason for visit
sections.instructions: Please describe the main reason you are seeking care today.

questions.text: What is the main reason for your visit today?
questions.conversational_hint: Let's start with the reason you're here — what's the main thing you'd like addressed today?

questions.text: Is this a new problem or an ongoing one?
questions.conversational_hint: Is this something new, or is it a problem you've been dealing with for a while?

options.label: Follow-up for a previously diagnosed condition

sections.title: Past medical history
sections.instructions: Please indicate any medical conditions you have been diagnosed with, past or present.

questions.text: Do you have any of the following diagnosed conditions? (Select all that apply)
questions.conversational_hint: Have you ever been diagnosed with any of the following? Go ahead and mention everything, even if it's well-controlled.

questions.text: If you have cancer, what type?
questions.conversational_hint: You mentioned cancer — what type were you diagnosed with, if you don't mind sharing?

sections.title: Surgical history
sections.instructions: List any surgeries you have had, including the approximate year.

questions.text: Have you had any surgeries in the past?
questions.conversational_hint: Have you had any surgeries or procedures done — anything from a minor outpatient procedure to a major surgery?

questions.text: Please list your past surgeries and the approximate year each was performed.
questions.conversational_hint: Can you list the surgeries you've had and roughly when they were done?

sections.title: Medications
sections.instructions: List all medications you are currently taking, including prescription, over-the-counter, and supplements.

questions.text: Are you currently taking any medications, vitamins, or supplements?
questions.conversational_hint: Are you currently taking any medications — prescription, over-the-counter, vitamins, or supplements?

questions.text: Please list your current medications, doses, and what you take them for.
questions.conversational_hint: Can you walk me through the medications you're on — the name, dose if you know it, and what it's for?

sections.title: Allergies
sections.instructions: List any known drug or food allergies and the reactions they cause.

questions.text: Do you have any known allergies to medications, foods, or environmental substances?
questions.conversational_hint: Do you have any allergies — to medications, foods, or anything in the environment like pollen or latex?

questions.text: Please list your known allergies and describe the reaction each causes.
questions.conversational_hint: What are you allergic to, and what kind of reaction does each one cause?

sections.title: Social history
sections.instructions: These questions help us understand lifestyle factors that affect your health.

questions.text: Do you currently use tobacco products?
questions.conversational_hint: Do you smoke or use any tobacco products — cigarettes, cigars, pipe, chewing tobacco, or vaping?

questions.text: How much do you smoke, and for how many years?
questions.conversational_hint: About how much do you smoke per day, and how long have you been smoking?

questions.text: Do you drink alcohol?
questions.conversational_hint: Do you drink alcohol at all?

questions.text: How often do you drink, and how many drinks on a typical day?
questions.conversational_hint: How often would you say you drink, and on a day when you do drink, roughly how many drinks?

questions.text: How would you describe your level of physical activity?
questions.conversational_hint: How physically active are you on a typical week?

options.label: Vigorous — more than 3 times per week

questions.text: Have you used recreational or street drugs in the past two years?
questions.conversational_hint: Have you used any recreational drugs in the past couple of years?

sections.title: Family history
sections.instructions: Please indicate any significant health conditions in your immediate family.

questions.text: Do any of your close family members (parents, siblings, grandparents) have or have had any significant health conditions?
questions.conversational_hint: Do any of your close relatives — parents, siblings, grandparents — have any significant health conditions like heart disease, diabetes, cancer, or stroke?

questions.text: Please describe the family member and their condition.
questions.conversational_hint: Can you tell me which family member and what condition — for example, 'My father had a heart attack at 55' or 'My mother has type 2 diabetes'?

sections.title: Review of systems
sections.instructions: Are you currently experiencing any of the following symptoms? Check all that apply.

questions.text: General symptoms
questions.conversational_hint: Let me run through a quick symptom check. Starting with general symptoms — are you experiencing fatigue, unintended weight loss or gain of more than 10 pounds, or fever?

options.label: Weight gain of more than 10 lbs
Weight loss of more than 10 lbs

questions.text: Cardiovascular and respiratory symptoms
questions.conversational_hint: What about heart or breathing symptoms — chest pain, shortness of breath, racing heartbeat, or swollen ankles?

questions.text: Neurological symptoms
questions.conversational_hint: Any neurological symptoms — headaches, dizziness, numbness or tingling, or fainting spells?

questions.text: Gastrointestinal symptoms
questions.conversational_hint: Any stomach or bowel symptoms — abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, constipation, or heartburn?

questions.text: Psychiatric symptoms
questions.conversational_hint: Any mood or mental health concerns — depression, anxiety, insomnia, or mood swings?
